unmapped_findings: Measured chemical composition of the 28Mn5Ni alloy (Table 1, wt.%): Mn 28.1 ± 0.4, Al 8.6 ± 0.04, C 0.9 ± 0.01, Ni 4.8 ± 0.04, Fe balance; this composition is alloy-level (common to all 28Mn5Ni process samples).

In the hot rolled (HR) condition the selected alloys exhibited about 20–70% total tensile elongation to failure at room temperature, with 15Mn5Ni showing the lowest ductility (from prior study [21]); the elongation is not resolved specifically for 28Mn5Ni, so it is recorded only as a range covering all three alloys.
The 28Mn5Ni alloy was rolled successfully without cracking at room temperature up to 50% reduction; the HR condition is the starting state for that subsequent cold rolling.
In the HR condition the alloy composition was chosen such that the B2 phase fraction varied from 0 to ~12% in HR condition across the three alloys, with 28Mn5Ni containing ~4% B2.
